constraint_model.buffer_basis: ENGINEERING JUDGEMENT, not statute. Back-calculated from L_WA = 88 dB(A) measured on a 40 MVA 110-kV transformer bank with forced cooling (Ing.-Buero Greiner, UW Unterschleissheim, 2008) through hemispherical decay Lp = L_WA - 20log10(r) - 8 dB: 40 dB(A) night (allgemeines Wohngebiet, TA Laerm Nr. 6.1) is reached at 141 m with the +3 dB Tonzuschlag for the 100/200 Hz hum, and at 282 m once the 6 dB Irrelevanz margin of TA Laerm Nr. 3.2.1(2) is added. 300 m also covers a reines Wohngebiet at 35 dB(A) without margins (251 m). Documented DSO practice puts the floor at 200 m (B-Plan 'Umspannwerk', Stadt Woerth am Main, 2020). ALKIS cannot distinguish WA/WR/MD, so the WA reading is the conservative one; a Dorfgebiet fringe would legally justify ~160 m.
constraint_model.why: TA Laerm night value cannot be held at short range (see buffer_basis)

constraint_model.buffer_basis: Sec. 9(1) Nr. 1 FStrG (Bundesstr.) / Sec. 23(1) Nr. 1 HStrG (L, K): 20 m (statute). WRONG DATUM, DELIBERATELY CONSERVATIVE, AND IT MATTERS: the statute measures from the outer edge of the BEFESTIGTE FAHRBAHN, but ALKIS Strassenverkehr is the whole Verkehrsflaeche including verges, embankments and ditches. Measured over the farm window, the three K 431 polygons are 14-17 m wide (area / half perimeter) where the carriageway of a Kreisstrasse is ~6-7 m, so buffering the polygon over-measures the statutory zone by roughly 4-5 m PER SIDE. Substation_5 -- the one candidate this layer decides -- clears the burned buffer by 14.44 m and so misses by 5.56 m, which is the SAME ORDER as the datum error. Its failure must not be reported as a clean statutory result: either narrow the source geometry to the carriageway (ALKIS ave_Nutzung cannot do it; a Strassennetz layer such as ATKIS Basis-DLM can) or state the margin explicitly.
constraint_model.why: Sec. 9(1)/23(1): verboten; the Sec. 9(8)/23(8) Ausnahme is discretionary

constraint_model.buffer_basis: ASSUMPTION, NOT STATUTE. German law contains no Anbauverbotszone for railways comparable to Sec. 9 FStrG; proximity is handled by case-by-case Zustimmung of the Eisenbahninfrastrukturunternehmen and by operational rules (DGUV 201-021: 3,0 m to live overhead-line parts; earthing of conductive structures within 4 m of track centre). 20 m is adopted for consistency with the road classes and must be presented as an assumption. Set to 0 to fall back to excluding only the ALKIS Bahnverkehr polygons themselves.
constraint_model.why: operational clearance and DB Zustimmung; the track itself is already forbidden

constraint_model.buffer_basis: ENGINEERING JUDGEMENT, not statute. Sec. 34 BNatSchG creates NO buffer, and its text says nothing about distance: Sec. 34(1) catches any project 'geeignet, das Gebiet erheblich zu beeintraechtigen', which the settled reading -- not the wording -- extends to projects outside the boundary. A nonzero screening zone is therefore defensible but is NOT a statutory figure and must not be presented as one. Set to 0 for the statutory-minimum sensitivity run; the recommended band is 0-500 m.
